searchResults.title: grabjobs
searchResults.highlight:
GrabJobs is a Human Resources Services company. GrabJobs is a platform that helps employers find job listings, job trends, and career resources. It offers a job search platform for employers, allowing users to search for jobs in Colombia and explore companies. The platform also provides resources for job seekers to develop their careers and start new jobs. GrabJobs aims to help employers find jobs and help them find jobs in the country. GrabJobs employs 14 people and has an annual revenue of $2.2M, founded in 2016. Headquartered in United States, with presence in Singapore and Philippines. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Singapore, Philippines, France, Thailand, and United Kingdom). Has $2.9M in total funding, with 6 prior funding rounds.
